comparison.objective: Move a heavy carton onto a low platform using edge placement and pushing; candidate tunes a compact damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Manage a large load through tilt, edge support, and whole-body pushing versus millimetric tool engagement, collar adjustment, relocking, and guarded actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Carton securely supported on the platform without loss or unsafe motion versus two bounded impact stops without bottoming, overload, or drift.
comparison.reason: Heavy-object levering and fine commissioning test meaningfully different abilities.
